name: Bedtime Stories
description: Choose a hero, a place and a theme and your AI writes a gentle story, read aloud at bedtime.
prompt: Bedtime stories for children: pick a hero, a place and a theme and Acornix.askAI writes a gentle short story with the onText option so it appears as it is written, read aloud slowly with Acornix.speak, a dark calm screen, and saved favourite stories.
